Linear programs in scales, read by their LP certificates: one price per row of the given, a farkas line over the
rows, and the points (feasible, attaining the value). The programs: one of type I, a triangle, both vertices of a
two-node tree program, and the silent program of a ladder step.

\section{Programs}\label{sec:programs}

\begin{lemma}[{the program of type I}]\label{lem:typeone}
The program of type I.
\begin{stmt}
\sit{given}{v_s,v_a,v_b,v_k\in \Q_{\ge0},\ 4 v_s+2 v_a \ge 1,\ 4 v_s+2 v_b \ge 1,\ 4 v_s+4 v_k \ge 1,\ 6 v_s \ge 1}
\sit{(1)}{6 v_s+v_a+v_b+v_k \ge 17/12}
\sit{at}{v_s:=1/6,\ v_a:=1/6,\ v_b:=1/6,\ v_k:=1/12}
\sit{(2)}{6 v_s+v_a+v_b+v_k = 17/12\Rightarrow v_s = 1/6,\ v_a = 1/6,\ v_b = 1/6,\ v_k = 1/12}
\end{stmt}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
Weak duality; the optimum is unique.
\begin{plines}
\pline{(1)}{The goal follows by the prices \(1/2, 1/2, 1/4, 1/6\) of the rows.}
\pline{(2)}{Each part of the goal follows from the facts at hand.}
\end{plines}
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}[{a triangle of optima}]\label{lem:triangle}
A tie: the optimal face is a triangle, so m = 3.
\begin{stmt}
\sit{given}{v_s,v_x,v_t,v_y\in \Q_{\ge0},\ v_s+v_y \ge 1/2,\ v_x+v_t \ge 1/2,\ v_x+v_y \ge 1/2}
\sit{(1)}{v_s+v_x+v_t+v_y \ge 1}
\sit{at}{v_s:=1/2,\ v_x:=1/2,\ v_t:=0,\ v_y:=0;\ v_s:=0,\ v_x:=0,\ v_t:=1/2,\ v_y:=1/2;\ v_s:=0,\ v_x:=1/2,\ v_t:=0,\ v_y:=1/2}
\sit{(2)}{v_s+v_x+v_t+v_y = 1\Rightarrow v_s+v_y = 1/2,\ v_x+v_t = 1/2}
\end{stmt}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
The two priced rows are tight on the optimal face.
\begin{plines}
\pline{(1)}{The goal follows by the prices \(1, 1, 0\) of the rows.}
\pline{(2)}{Each part of the goal follows from the facts at hand.}
\end{plines}
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}[{two nodes, the site vertex}]\label{lem:twonodeA}
The two-node tree program, k = K + 2: the site vertex, where eta K >= 3.
\begin{stmt}
\sit{given}{K,\eta\in \Q_{>0},\ \eta K \ge 3,\ y,v_r,v_B,z\in \Q_{\ge0},\ 2 y \ge 1,\ v_B \ge v_r,\ 2 z+2 v_B \ge 1,\ 3 v_B+\eta v_r \ge 1}
\sit{(1)}{y+v_r+(K+1) v_B+z \ge 1+(K+1)/(3+\eta)}
\sit{at}{y:=1/2,\ v_r:=1/(3+\eta),\ v_B:=1/(3+\eta),\ z:=(1+\eta)/(2\cdot (3+\eta))}
\end{stmt}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
The order row is priced (eta K - 3)/(3 + eta), the hypothesis times 1/(3 + eta).
\begin{plines}
\pline{(1)}{The goal follows by the prices \(1/2, 1/(3+\eta) h_1, 1/2, (K+1)/(3+\eta)\) of the rows.}
\end{plines}
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}[{two nodes, the free vertex}]\label{lem:twonodeB}
The free vertex, where eta K <= 3.
\begin{stmt}
\sit{given}{K,\eta\in \Q_{>0},\ \eta K \le 3,\ y,v_r,v_B,z\in \Q_{\ge0},\ 2 y \ge 1,\ v_B \ge v_r,\ 2 z+2 v_B \ge 1,\ 3 v_B+\eta v_r \ge 1}
\sit{(1)}{y+v_r+(K+1) v_B+z \ge 1+K/3}
\sit{at}{y:=1/2,\ v_r:=0,\ v_B:=1/3,\ z:=1/6}
\end{stmt}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
The reduced cost of v_r is 1 - eta K/3, the hypothesis times v_r/3.
\begin{plines}
\pline{(1)}{The goal follows by the prices \(1/2, 0, 1/2, K/3\) of the rows.}
\end{plines}
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}[{a silent minimum}]\label{lem:silentprog}
The silent program of a ladder step at D = 2 + E > 2: the value 1/D at (0, 1/D), alone.
\begin{stmt}
\sit{given}{E\in \Q_{>0},\ v_S,v_e\in \Q_{\ge0},\ 2 v_S+(2+E) v_e \ge 1}
\sit{(1)}{v_S+v_e \ge 1/(2+E)}
\sit{at}{v_S:=0,\ v_e:=1/(2+E)}
\sit{(2)}{v_S+v_e = 1/(2+E)\Rightarrow v_S \le 0}
\end{stmt}
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
The reduced cost of v_S is E/(2 + E); on the optimal face E v_S <= 0.
\begin{plines}
\pline{(1)}{The goal follows by the prices \(1/(2+E)\) of the rows.}
\pline{(2)}{The goal follows dividing by \(E\), combining \(2+E\) times \((\mathrm{I}_{1})\) and \((\mathrm{H}_{3})\).}
\end{plines}
\end{proof}
